items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: the bassist was Joe Comfort and the guitar player was John Collins

ctx.x: Rossolini (sic) -- Frank Rossolini [ROSSOLINO]. Stan Kenton had quite a band then, with a lot of musicians. As a matter of fact, he had five saxophones, five trombones, five trumpets, and four in the rhythm section. I think it was the best band that I have ever heard of Stan Kenton's.

Anyway, along with, as I said before, the Nat King Cole Trio, which at that particular time the bassist was Joe Comfort and the guitar player was John Collins, a very fine guitarist and a long-time friend. They made up the Nat King Cole Trio. Of course, there was John (sic: GEORGE) Kirby, Peg Leg Bates. It just made for a very happy situation. That
